d:
Chhath puja ke paranprik bhojpuri git hain, jinmen sup, nariyal, gangaji, chhathi maiya ki aarti aur arghy ki paranpra hai
chhath puja git sangrah | Chhath Puja Special Bhojpuri Songs | Chhathi Maiya Ke Geet
Chhathi maiya ki bhakti aur sury dev ki upasna ko samarpit prastut hai paranprik bhojpuri chhath puja giton ka vishesh sangraha. chhath mahaparv ki pavan paranpraon, ganga maiya ki mahima, puja ke sup, nariyal, phal aur sury dev ko arghy arpit karne ki bhakti bhavna se jure in madhur giton ke sath chhathi maiya ki aaradhna karen.
